title: [Master] - Bug 641894: [Expense Agent] [Rules] Mileage expense should not validate require receipt number rule
summary: Mileage expenses in Expense Agent no longer incorrectly trigger the receipt number mandatory validation rule, since mileage never has receipts.
key_points: Mileage expenses are now excluded from the require receipt number validation
The fix applies to both initial expense and expense report line validation
Validation logic now checks expense type before applying the rule
Tests added to verify mileage expenses bypass receipt number checks
Non-mileage expenses continue to enforce receipt number requirements when enabled
quote: Mileage expense should not validate require receipt number rule
